summary: The agent demonstrates good practices in cross-validation, feature engineering, and stacking, but introduces critical data leakage. Specifically, applying TfidfVectorizer, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding to the combined train and test dataset leaks test set statistics directly into the training data. Additionally, it relies solely on accuracy as an evaluation metric without checking for class imbalances.
